mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU offers several advantages for homeowners. It can provide a flexible living space for family members, such as aging parents or adult children, or serve as a dedicated home office or guest suite. Many homeowners also use ADUs to generate rental income, helping to offset mortgage payments or increase overall property value. Attached ADUs can sometimes be more cost-effective to build than detached units due to shared utilities or structural elements. They also contribute to increased housing density in communities without requiring new land development.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include flexible living space for family or guests, potential rental income, increased property value, and often lower construction costs compared to detached units.
